mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, color, display_order, is_default FROM categories WHERE user_id IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, display_order, id
SELECT id, user_id, name, color, display_order, is_default FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId})
SELECT id, user_id, name, color, display_order, is_default FROM categories WHERE name = #{name} AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY is_default DESC, id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (user_id, user_scope_id, name, color, display_order, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, COALESCE(#{userId}, -1), #{name}, #{color}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(d.display_order), 0) + 1 FROM categories d WHERE d.user_id IS NULL OR d.user_id = #{userId}), FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET category_id = NULL, is_classified = FALSE, applied_rule_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE category_id = #{id}
